customer_jdoe: Hey team — our embeddings pipeline started failing this morning when traffic shifts between our Hosted and Dedicated routes. Hosted embeddings are length 768 but when requests hit Dedicated we sometimes get vectors of length 512. Indexer throws InvalidEmbeddingShape. Seen on ~10% of requests over last 30m.
jamie_support: sorry to hear that — can you paste a couple of request_ids and the model name you called? also which deployment modes are in play (hosted/dedicated/private)?
customer_jdoe: request_id: r-0a1b2c3d4e5f, r-111213141516. model param in calls: \u201crw-embed-v2\u201d. Traffic split: 80% hosted, 20% dedicated via our routing rule. private not involved.
jamie_support: got it. do you have the raw request payload for one of the fails? are you using batching on client side? any custom batching config on dedicated?
customer_jdoe: client sends a batch of 16 strings. We rely on platform batching. No custom dedicated config as far as we know. Attaching minimal repro: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rw-embed-v2","input":["a","b","c"]}'
```
jamie_support: thanks. quick check: what is the exact error from indexer when it receives length 512?
customer_jdoe: indexer log: 
```
ERROR: InvalidEmbeddingShape: expected 768 got 512 for vector id 42
```
jamie_support: ok. tagging infra & research — alex, sara can you take a quick look? adding opsbot logging.
opsbot: logs enabled for request_ids: r-0a1b2c3d4e5f, r-111213141516. Session capture started.
alex_infra: looking at routing traces — both requests hit different backends. r-0a1b... -> hosted pool-host-22; r-1112... -> dedicated-gpu-07. I can see response payload sizes differ. pulling raw responses.
sara_research: quick hypothesis: two different model artifacts behind the same model name (rw-embed-v2) across envs — one might be a quantized variant producing 512 dims (unlikely) or a truncated output due to KV-cache/batching bug. can you confirm model artifact ids?
jamie_support: customer, can you run this curl with the additional header to force route to hosted vs dedicated? add `X-Redwood-Route: hosted` and `X-Redwood-Route: dedicated` and paste responses. small batch (1) please.
customer_jdoe: tried that: hosted -> vector length 768; dedicated -> vector length 512. payloads attached.
alex_infra: confirmed. response bodies show different `vector.length` fields. I also see `model_build` meta: hosted: `rw-embed-v2@b3f9e2`, dedicated: `rw-embed-v2@a17d4c` — different builds. that explains mismatch.
sara_research: that explains parity issue — two builds should not be under same model alias. why did dedicated pick older build? possible rollout rollback or stale image on dedicated registry.
jamie_support: thanks. customer, immediate workaround: pin `model` to the explicit build id you want e.g. `rw-embed-v2@b3f9e2` in your request until we fix rollout. Also set `batch_size=1` or turn off server batching to avoid mixed-batch artifacts while we investigate.
customer_jdoe: pinning works, indexer happy. but we need a permanent fix. can you outline next steps and ETA?
alex_infra: were going to: 1) invalidate alias across Dedicated so alias points to the correct artifact, 2) run a consistency check across environments to detect artifact drift, 3) audit the rollout pipeline to prevent dangling images. Ill put a hotfix today.
sara_research: will also run a quick correctness check over 1000 sample inputs across builds to confirm numeric parity. if quantization or model conversion accidentally changed embedding dimension that would be very bad.
jamie_support: ops: can we surface an automated alert when model alias resolution returns different artifact ids across regions/pools?
opsbot: alert rule proposed: ModelAliasParityMismatch -> fire when alias resolves to >1 artifact_id in 1h window. Created PR #452.
customer_jdoe: thanks. two follow-ups: 1) billing/quotas: some requests were retried and double-billed? 2) any recommended client config to avoid this class of failure in future?
jamie_support: for billing — if we did double-charge due to retries we will reconcile; please open a billing ticket with the request_ids and we'll escalate finance. For client config: pin model_build if you require strong parity, set `max_batch_size: 1` or use `batch_timeout_ms` small, enable `response.meta.model_build` logging on ingest to detect silently.
alex_infra: hotfix deployed to Dedicated pool at 1977770120; alias now consistent (both pools return b3f9e2). doing a post-deploy smoke.
jamie_support: verified with customer: can you re-run your earlier route test?
customer_jdoe: re-run: hosted -> 768, dedicated -> 768. indexer green. thanks.
sara_research: follow-up: we will schedule a sweep to detect any other aliases with divergent builds and add a unit test in the deployment pipeline.
jamie_support: closing loop — please re-open if you see recurrence. adding note to support playbook: "If embeddings dim mismatch, check model_build in response, pin build, and escalate to infra if aliases differ." :white_check_mark:
